name: Fix TypeScript Error (Learning)
description: LLM-assisted type error fix that learns from patterns. Traces feed Thompson Sampling.

tasks.description: Parse TypeScript errors to identify affected files and error types

prompt.template:
Parse these TypeScript errors:

```
{{errorLog}}
```

For each error:
1. Extract file path and line number
2. Identify error code (TS2345, TS2322, etc.)
3. Understand what type mismatch or issue exists

Read the affected files to understand context.

tasks.description: Apply type fixes based on error analysis

prompt.template:
Fix the type errors identified:

Common approaches:
- TS2345 (Argument type): Check function signature, add type assertion if safe
- TS2322 (Type assignment): Ensure types match or narrow appropriately
- TS2339 (Property missing): Add to interface or use optional chaining
- TS2531 (Possibly null): Add null check or use non-null assertion if safe

Make minimal changes. Prefer fixing types over suppressing errors.
